u0: At this stage the blocking ball is still in front of the locked door, the door is shut, no matching key is held, and the target box has not been picked up. The required order is to move the ball out of the doorway first, then obtain the matching key, then unlock and open the door, and only after that collect the target box. Taking the key before the ball is cleared, opening the door before the key has been acquired, or reaching the box before the door has been opened would break a mandatory rule and fail the task. While handling the key later, the task also prefers that it not be dropped while the door remains closed, and that the door be opened when the key is held.
u1: A mandatory ordering has been violated: for example, the key was taken before the ball was out of the way, the door was opened before the matching key had been acquired or before the ball was cleared, or the target box was picked up before the door had been opened. The mission can no longer be completed successfully, and no further action can repair the failure.
u2: This stage is reached after the blocking ball has been moved out of the doorway at least once, with the door still closed, no matching key currently held, and the target box uncollected. The ball may since have been dropped back in front of the door; if so, it will need to be moved again before that doorway can be toggled, even though the required first clearing has already occurred. The next objective is to have the matching key in hand, then unlock and open the door before going for the box. The task prefers that the key not be dropped while the door remains closed once it is acquired.
u3: Here the blocking ball has been cleared at least once and the matching key has been acquired, but the door is still closed and the target box remains uncollected. The key may be in hand or may have been dropped again; if it is not currently held it must be recovered, and if the ball has been returned to the doorway it must be moved out again before the door can be opened. The remaining sequence is to open the door with the key and then collect the target box. Dropping the key while the door is still shut is discouraged but does not by itself fail the mission, and holding the key while the door stays closed should be resolved by opening the door.
u4: Reached after the door has been opened with the matching key while the target box is still uncollected. The required ordering for the ball, key, and door is already satisfied, and the remaining objective is to pick up the target box in the far room. The door may still be open or may have been closed again, and it can be reopened; the key may be held or left behind, though a ball returned to the doorway could need clearing again. Dropping or losing the key after the door has been opened does not prevent success.
u5: The designated target box has been picked up, so the mission is complete and the episode ends successfully. The ball had been moved out of the way, the matching key had been acquired, and the door was opened before the box was collected. All mandatory requirements are satisfied, and no further objective remains.
u6: This stage follows an earlier opening of the door: the door is currently shut, the target box is still uncollected, and the agent entered with the matching key in hand. The required ordering remains satisfied, so success is still possible; the objective is to reopen the door if it separates the agent from the box, then pick up the target box. The task prefers that, if the key is still held while the door is shut, the door be opened rather than the key dropped; dropping it now counts against that preference but does not by itself make the mission fail. Once the door is open again, or if the box can already be reached, progress can continue to the final pickup.
